integrity: Analytical proof supplies infinite-parameter statement; standalone numerical checks are corroboration and not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Independent equal-variance circular complex Gaussian coefficients only; logarithmic (not exponential) Mahler measure on the full circle; no CLT, no quantitative error beyond the stated little-o term, no historical-priority guarantee.
title: Two-term variance law for the logarithmic Mahler measure of Gaussian polynomials
